title: cudagraphR 0.1.1
text: Documented tested composition bounded-memory batched cudalearnr::cuda_knn() result. Mutual kNN graphs now require directed neighbour relations instead counting duplicate occurrences undirected key. Duplicate neighbours within one observation rejected, asymmetric reciprocal weights retain stronger affinity.
